blocks.value: Support is a price level where buyers usually become active, preventing the stock from falling further.
Imagine This: Drop a basketball onto the floor. The floor stops it from falling further and the ball bounces back. Support acts like the floor for a stock price.
When a stock reaches a support level, many investors believe it is a good buying opportunity, increasing demand.
If a stock repeatedly falls to around ₹500 and then rises again, ₹500 may be acting as a support level.
Support is an area, not an exact price.
